subject: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@atlasai.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call today. We’re aiming to go live with AtlasAI customer-facing features in Q4 and need clear SLA options and pricing to take into procurement ASAP. High level:
- Target committed usage: ~200–300M tokens / month (we can finalize after an initial pilot)
- Required uptime: at least 99.95% for the primary region, with cross-region failover
- P1 response SLA: 1 hour; P2 within 4 hours; 24/7 escalation coverage for Sev1s
- We’ll need a statement on credits for downtime and a runbook for incident handoff

Security & procurement asked for a short questionnaire and any existing SOW templates — I attached the security questionnaire we use (security-questionnaire.pdf). Can you share a straightforward pricing grid and a sample SOW? Procurement is Tim Chen (tim.chen@atlasai.com).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Li
Head of Platform, AtlasAI
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@atlasai.com>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@atlasai.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout

Hi Emma — great to connect today. Appreciate the clear requirements. Attaching a concise pricing grid that lays out our uptime tiers and support packaging (SLA_Pricing_Grid.xlsx). Summary below so procurement has a quick read:

SLA tiers (hosted API):
- Standard: 99.9% uptime, business-hours triage, no retainer
- Premium: 99.95% uptime, 24/7 P1 coverage, 1-hour P1 response target, retainer-based on coverage
- Enterprise+: 99.99% uptimes with multi-region failover, dedicated on-call rotation

Support/financials snapshot:
- Credits: sliding scale credits applied to monthly invoice; larger commitments reduce credit caps
- Retainer: optional for 24/7 on-call (reduces response windows and includes direct pager escalation)
- Discounts: available for 12+ month committed consumption and prepayment

I’ll loop in our SEs and Solutions team to draft a proposal aligned to 200–300M tokens/month. Can you confirm procurement cadence (PO vs DocuSign) and whether AtlasAI prefers an annual commit or quarterly? I’ll attach a sample SOW and pricing deck in the next message.

Attachments: SLA_Pricing_Grid.xlsx (attached)

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-08-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout — pricing/packaging ask

Internal — forwarding AtlasAI thread. Key asks: 24/7 P1 (1 hour), 99.95% primary uptime, cross-region failover, and a commitment target of 200–300M tokens/month. Procurement contact is Tim Chen.

They mentioned a security questionnaire (attached), and they want a sample SOW. Atlas has asked for discounting; during the call they signaled they’d push for ~20% off list if we can guarantee a 12-month commit.

Requests:
- Ben: can you draft a proposal that includes a pilot (90 days) and a committed 12-month option at both list and discounted pricing? Highlight retainer amount for 24/7 on-call and the credit formula for downtime.
- Vanessa: can you check legal on standard escape clauses for pilot -> full commit transitions (we want a clean canary exit option)?

Attaching: AtlasAI_RFP.zip (contains their security questionnaire)

Thanks — Priya
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout — pricing/packaging ask

Thanks Priya — reviewed the ask. Draft recommendations below; I’ve attached a working proposal draft (Proposal_Draft_AtlasAI.docx) with numbers you can iterate on.

Recommendation (high level):
- Pilot: 90 days, up to 50M tokens/month, 15% pilot discount off list hosted rates; includes basic incident SLAs (business-hours P1) and a lightweight runbook.
- Production commit: 12 months, 300M tokens/month committed (monthly true-up allowed), 18% off list for commit, with a tiered scale if they step up to 500M+.
- Uptime model: Primary served at Premium (99.95%) with cross-region failover to Standard variant (99.9%) — reduces cost for failover usage while preserving continuity.
- On-call/retainer: $15,000/month baseline for 24/7 dedicated escalation lane; we can offer a reduced retainer to $12,000/month if Atlas commits 12 months and prepays quarterly.
- Credits: 10% monthly invoice credit for monthly availability <99.95% but >=99.9%; 30% credit for availability <99.9% — tiered and capped per contract.
- Exit/canary: include a 30-day notice for pilot termination; if they convert mid-pilot to commit we pro-rate the discount and apply a one-time onboarding credit.

Open items: legal OK on the credit caps and whether finance will allow the prepay discount. Vanessa — any redlines on retainer/credit caps?

Attaching: Proposal_Draft_AtlasAI.docx

- Ben
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@atlasai.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA for AtlasAI production rollout — Redwood counteroffer

Hi Emma / Tim — thanks for the patience while we modeled options. Based on your stated goals, here’s a concise counteroffer that balances availability, cost, and operational coverage: 

1) Pilot (recommended first step)
 - Duration: 90 days
 - Volume: up to 50M tokens/month
 - Pricing: 15% discount off list hosted rates for the pilot period
 - SLA: business-hours P1 (target 2 hours), 24/7 monitoring and escalation available on request
 - Purpose: validate latency and failover behavior with minimal commitment

2) Production commit (if you proceed to full rollout)
 - Term: 12 months
 - Committed volume: 300M tokens/month (monthly true-up allowed)
 - Discount: 18% off list hosted rates (with escalator to 22% at 500M+ tokens)
 - Uptime: Premium 99.95% primary with cross-region failover to Standard (99.9%)
 - On-call retainer: $12,000/month (reduced from list $15k because of a 12-month commit + quarterly prepay option)
 - Response targets: P1 = 1 hour, P2 = 4 hours, P3 = next-business-day
 - Credits: tiered credits to monthly invoice (10% credit for availability between 99.9–99.95%, 30% credit for availability <99.9%), capped per month (details in attached draft).

3) Commercial/legal logistics
 - We can sign via DocuSign (link below) or accept PO depending on procurement preference.
 - If you choose the pilot and do not convert, there is a 30-day wrap period and no additional penalties. If you convert mid-pilot to commit, we backdate the discount to pilot start.

Attachments: Proposal_Draft_AtlasAI.docx, AtlasAI_SOW_v1.pdf, SLA_Pricing_Grid.xlsx
Links: https://www.docusign.com/Sign?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d-atlasai-2027, HubSpot record https://hubspot.company/record/ATLAS-2027-001

Next steps: please confirm whether you want the pilot to start the week of Aug 23, and if procurement prefers DocuSign or a PO. I’ll schedule a short pilot kickoff and share a tailored runbook and onboarding plan once we have approval.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
